Turn Audio into Text in Minutes | TranscribeVoice

# Accurate transcription with Whisper. Try it for $1.

Send any audio or video file and get a clean, timestamped transcript from OpenAI's Whisper large-v3-turbo, with automatic speaker labels. About 30¢ an hour. Start with the $1 trial.

100+ languages, auto detected Speaker labels included$1 to try, credits never expire

## Try it now

Pick a file to start. We create your account and the $1 trial, then transcribe it with Whisper.

Upload Import Record

Drop your audio or video file here

Tap to select a file

or click to browse. MP3, MP4, WAV, and 20+ formats.

## Everything you need

From first upload to final export, the full toolkit for working with audio.

#### Batch upload entire projects

Drop multiple files at once. Each one transcribed in parallel.

#### Import from 1000+ sources

Paste a YouTube, Google Drive, or Instagram link. We transcribe it for you.

#### Record audio in one click

One click to start. Your audio and transcript land in the library together.

#### Works in 100+ languages

From English to Japanese to Arabic. 100+ languages, all ready to go.

#### Know who said what

Detect speakers automatically and rename them in one click. Colored labels make it obvious who is talking.

#### Search inside any transcript

Find the exact word or phrase. Jump to the timestamp instantly.

#### Edit any line, instantly

Click a sentence, fix a typo, save. Your edits flow through every export.

#### Take notes while you listen

Jot ideas, paste timestamps, link straight to any moment. Notes auto-save and stay glued to the transcript.

#### Organize with folders and favorites

Build your audio library. Folders, favorites, drag and drop.

#### AI extracts the key moments

Let AI summarize your transcript into timestamped key points.

#### Chat with your transcripts

Ask a question, get an answer with a timestamp. AI reads the transcript for you.

#### One recording, every format you ship

Turn a transcript into a blog post, X thread, LinkedIn copy, email draft, executive summary, key points, or a fluent translation. Click once, publish everywhere.

#### Export to Word, PDF, subtitles

Download in any format. DOCX, PDF, SRT, VTT, TXT, or MP3.

#### Share transcripts with a link

One click to create a public link. Anyone can read along and listen.

#### Share entire folders

Give collaborators access to a full project folder.

## Your recordings, kept private.

Processed only to produce your transcript. No AI training.

## Start with the $1 Whisper trial.

Whisper runs OpenAI's large-v3-turbo model on our GPUs. Try it on one real file for $1, then add credits as you go. Credits never expire.

Whisper transcription$0.30 per hour (15 credits)

Minimum per file 5 credits (about $0.10)

One credit about $0.02

So 10 hours of audio is about $3, and 40 hours is about $12. AI features cost a few credits each.

Try Whisper for $1

Terms and conditions apply.

What can I spend credits on?

AI summary or key points: about 5 credits on a short file, 10 on an hour.

Repurpose to tweets or LinkedIn: about 5 credits.

Blog post: about 6 credits.

Translate: about 10 credits on a short file, 50 on an hour.

Chat: 5 to 10 credits per message, based on file length.

Speaker labels: always included with Whisper.
